title: Affine birationality from a compatible fraction-ring isomorphism
statement: Let X,Y,S be affine schemes [def-weil-affine-spectrum], with X and Y integral [def-pc-integral-scheme]. Let sX:X→S and sY:Y→S be locally of finite type morphisms [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Put B=Gamma(X,O), C=Gamma(Y,O), A=Gamma(S,O). Suppose e:Frac(B)≃Frac(C) is a ring isomorphism such that for every a in A, e of the image of sX^*(a) in Frac(B) equals the image of sY^*(a) in Frac(C). Then X and Y are birational over S: there exist dense open subschemes and an S-isomorphism between them. This uses neither a hypersurface presentation nor geometric integrality.

proof.text: Use functionField_isFractionRing_of_isAffineOpen and the canonical localization algebra equivalences to turn e into an isomorphism of the generic-stalk function fields. Its compatibility with base sections follows from the algebra-equivalence commutation equations and he. Taking Spec contravariantly gives eSpec. Cancel S.toSpecΓ, use fromSpecStalk_toSpecΓ and toSpecΓ_naturality, and check equality of ring maps on each base section to prove eSpec is over S.

Extend eSpec.hom followed by the generic inclusion into Y and eSpec.inv followed by the generic inclusion into X using Mathlib PartialMap.ofFromSpecStalk. Its generic restriction and over-base equations give the two maps with exactly the required generic values.

Apply generic inverse partial-map restrictions. Package its two mutually inverse morphisms into a scheme isomorphism and then a PartialIso. Use the forward restriction equation and ofFromSpecStalk_comp, then homOfLE_ι, to establish PartialIso.IsOver.

proof_origin.note: Lean proof via spreading out inverse generic maps, instead of constructing the generated common subalgebra. The unit realization lists are empty for this item; no unit step is bypassed.

theorem birationalOver_of_fractionRing_equiv
    {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine Y] [IsAffine S]
    [IsIntegral X] [IsIntegral Y]
    (sX : X ⟶ S) (sY : Y ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType sX] [LocallyOfFiniteType sY]
    (e : FractionRing Γ(X, ⊤) ≃+* FractionRing Γ(Y, ⊤))
    (he : ∀ a : Γ(S, ⊤),
      e (algebraMap Γ(X, ⊤) (FractionRing Γ(X, ⊤)) (sX.appTop.hom a)) =
        algebraMap Γ(Y, ⊤) (FractionRing Γ(Y, ⊤)) (sY.appTop.hom a)) :
    Scheme.BirationalOver sX sY
